svg.title: Pleural effusion constellation — nested taxonomy and small multiples
svg.desc: Taxonomic subsumption is shown as literal containment. Below it, source-centered cards show each typed relationship and all of its properties locally, followed by binding and anatomy cards.
svg.text: Containment answers “what kind of thing?” Cards answer “what relationship, in which direction, with which properties?”

g.text: Every inner box is a SUBTYPE_OF its enclosing box · label may change inside the tree
One source per card · one local arrow · expected describes the target under that cause
No specificity appears on causal edges.

g.aria-label: Manifestation, progression, cause, and co-occurrence cards
g.text: Different relationship families keep different borders, labels, and arrow colors

g.aria-label: Data element bindings and anatomy scope
g.text: Element edges are direct bindings; taxonomy does not imply inheritance
Each of the six diagnosis subtypes separately binds required presence; the parent binding is not inherited.
atelectasis: presence + severity · thickening: presence + distribution
mediastinal shift, split pleura sign, nodular thickening: presence

svg.text: Canonical sources: graph/core.jsonl and graph/pleural-effusion.jsonl. Repeated chips are references to the same node, not duplicate classes.
